name: Quad EMA 8/13/21/55 fan with 21/55 cross, +150/-1000 points exit
author: Pine community script (from YouTube clip)
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Flat; EMA21 crosses above EMA55 (script uses crossunder(ema55, ema21)) AND EMA21>EMA55, EMA13>EMA21, EMA8>EMA13 -> long.
entry_short: EMA21 crosses below EMA55 with EMA21<EMA55, EMA13<EMA21, EMA8<EMA13 -> short.
exit: Stop 150 points, take profit 1000 points; also close and reverse when EMA55/EMA21 cross opposite.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Point-based exits depend on instrument tick scaling.
